svg.title: IconMarkExclude
svg.desc: Incompatibility-rule marks. explorer.html's MARK map carries a note that help.html's legend documents these three verbatim: "Change one, change the other, or the legend stops describing the app." They are therefore kept as their own keys rather than aliased onto the visually similar IconClose / IconArrowRight, so a future change to the window chrome cannot silently redefine what a rule means. The flag's fill-only accent wash is dropped (single-stroke path).
